referenceConsumerSemantics.meaning: A non-forced child uses the target mesh named bone world position. Preserve local mesh scale and local rotation when computing that world position.

The effect rotation consumer uses target GetRotateDegree (m_vRotate). LOCAL_ROTATE_EFFECT writes template Rotate to m_vRotateLocal; the full mesh/bone matrix uses m_vRotate plus m_vRotateLocal. Thus -7 degrees affects Brandish dummy and attack world positions, but adding it again to child global rotation would double-apply local rotation.
Child scale uses member and optional instance scale. The target mesh local Size already changes its dummy world positions; it does not justify multiplying all child particle sizes by 0.8.
Offset application uses owner and target direction. Preserve raw -100; its facing-relative interpretation is exercised on the tested straight Garpai lane.
